_comment: Copy to devices.json (gitignored) and describe your own hardware.
kind selects how a burst is produced:
remote_raw       - remote.send_command with a raw b64 carrier packet
remote_learned   - replay a learned command (for devices that drop raw sends)
select_and_press - pick a learned signal slot, then press a Send button
raw_action       - a custom action taking a raw code list (e.g. ESPHome)

tvs.name: TV A
tvs.verify: Verify received steps via its media_player volume_level (read before/after).

tvs.name: TV B
tvs.verify: No integration for this TV expected - verify on screen.

devices.name: Blaster A
devices.note: Burst = sustained ~3 s continuous 38 kHz carrier via the raw action.

devices.name: Blaster B
devices.note: Test burst sends a raw sustained-carrier b64 packet - no learning needed. Volume commands need learned codes (remote.learn_command).

devices.name: Blaster C
devices.note: Raw b64 sends are unreliable here, so the burst replays a learned command instead.

devices.name: Blaster D
devices.note: Replays learned signal slots only. Learn a long signal into the burst slot for a near-continuous blast.

devices.name: Blaster E
devices.note: Hub-style blaster exposed as a virtual media_player.
